description: SPDX licence identifiers a runtime distribution may carry (DEPT28_SPEC D13, ST-01/02). devtools/licence_gate.py normalises each installed distribution's licence to an SPDX id and refuses anything outside this list; a LicenseRef-/UNKNOWN entry is accepted only when licence_exceptions.json names the distribution with the file that proves its licence. Hash pinned in config.py. The five ids under additions_beyond_spec_d13 were needed by the resolved runtime set (uv.lock) and are recorded in ADR 0011 as a deviation from the lead's D13 list.

additions_beyond_spec_d13.MIT-0: cffi 2.1.1 (MIT No Attribution: MIT minus the attribution clause; permissive)
additions_beyond_spec_d13.MIT-CMU: pillow 12.3.0 (the historical CMU/MIT-style permissive notice; OSI-listed as MIT-CMU)
additions_beyond_spec_d13.Zlib: numpy 2.5.3 bundles zlib-licensed components (BSD-3-Clause AND 0BSD AND MIT AND Zlib AND CC0-1.0); permissive
additions_beyond_spec_d13.CC0-1.0: numpy 2.5.3 bundles CC0 (public-domain dedication) components; permissive
additions_beyond_spec_d13.CNRI-Python: regex 2026.9.10 (Apache-2.0 AND CNRI-Python: the historic CNRI Python licence, permissive, OSI-approved)
